explication: UnifiedDB is a RISC-V information database plus tooling that turns architectural descriptions into specifications and developer artifacts. The principal workflow is to load and validate database objects, interpret IDL where needed, then generate documentation, toolchain inputs, or simulator code. The README documents the product capabilities and broad generation workflow; source excerpts and the SOURCE INDEX support only selected internal calls, so other subsystem relationships are omitted rather than inferred.
